title: boltz2-eval：Boltz-2 蛋白-配体亲和力头的单卡严格评测（DAVIS / AutoDock Vina 子集）
description:
Single-GPU (11 GB) strict evaluation of Boltz-2's affinity-prediction head on a DAVIS / AutoDock Vina subset: real persisted MSA, same-condition Vina control, Mantel permutation test (20,000 permutations), PoseBusters reference-free pose checks, and CPU-regenerable analysis. Headline is a negative result (no same-target ranking established; 0/27 poses pass loading checks) published with its confidence intervals.

boltz2-eval：单张 11 GB 卡部署 Boltz-2 并接入真实 MSA 的严格评测；同靶点排序未建立（负结果如实公开），全部原始输出与确定性分析脚本随仓库发布。
